overview: 本期共收录 5 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在银行与信贷（3 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、金融经济学（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、GARCH 波动率模型为主。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: The Role of ESG Disclosure as a Moderator of the Influence of Transfer Pricing and Managerial Ownership on Tax Aggressiveness in Energy Sector Companies Listed on the IDX (2022–2024)
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study aims to examine the effect of transfer pricing and managerial ownership on tax aggressiveness, as well as to investigate the moderating role of Environmental, Social, and Governance disclosure. The study employs a quantitative approach using multiple linear regression analysis and Moderated Regression Analysis (MRA). The data were collected from the annual reports of energy sector companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) over a three-year period. Using a purposive sampling technique, the final sample consisted of 72 firm-year observations from 89 companies. The results indicate that transfer pricing has a positive and significant effect on tax aggressiveness, whereas managerial ownership has no significant effect. Furthermore, ESG disclosure is not found to moderate the relationship between either transfer pricing or managerial ownership and tax aggressiveness. These findings suggest that transfer pricing is one of the determinants of tax aggressiveness in energy sector companies, while ESG disclosure tends to be symbolic in nature and has not yet functioned effectively as a moderating mechanism.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究旨在探讨转让定价和管理层所有权对税收激进行为的影响，并分析环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息披露在其中的调节作用。研究采用定量方法，通过多元线性回归分析和调节回归分析（MRA）来进行研究。数据来源于印度尼西亚证券交易所（IDX）上市能源行业公司在三年期间的年度报告。通过目的性抽样技术，最终样本包括来自89家公司的72个公司-年份观测值。研究结果表明，转让定价对税收激进行为具有显著的正向影响，而管理层所有权则没有显著影响。此外，研究未发现ESG信息披露能够调节转让定价或管理层所有权与税收激进行为之间的关系。这些发现表明，转让定价是能源行业公司税收激进行为的一个决定因素，而ESG信息披露更多具有象征性意义，尚未有效发挥调节作用。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: A network analysis of systemic risk in the European banking sector
papers.abstract:
In this paper, we adopt a conditional tail risk network methodology for the assessment of transmission channels of risk. In particular, we employ weighted and directed networks to model the mutual influence between banks, with the weights being linked to tail risk measures. More specifically, in the empirical comparison we focus on MES-based pairwise dependence networks and on the parametric

 CoVaR network estimated on ARMA(1,1)-GARCH(1,1) residuals through SCAD-penalized quantile regression. We use different network indicators to investigate the importance of a bank’s role in both spreading and absorbing risk from other financial institutions. Our analysis focuses on a sample based on banks included in the European Banking Authority 2023 stress test, complemented by two additional systemically relevant European institutions and we consider daily data for the period 2015–2024. The analyses are conducted over four economically meaningful subperiods in order to evaluate the evolution of systemic interconnections across different macro-financial regimes. We find that the choice of tail risk measure leads to substantial differences in network topology, centrality rankings, and community composition. The empirical results demonstrate significant variations in the structural characteristics of the networks through time.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】在本文中，我们采用了一种条件尾部风险网络方法来评估风险传播渠道。具体而言，我们利用加权有向网络来模拟银行之间的相互影响，其中权重与尾部风险度量相关联。在实证比较中，我们重点关注基于MES（Meso-Economic Structure）的成对依赖网络，以及通过SCAD惩罚分位数回归方法在ARMA(1,1)-GARCH(1,1)残差上估计的参数化CoVaR网络。我们使用不同的网络指标来研究银行在传播和吸收其他金融机构风险方面的作用。我们的分析样本包括欧洲银行管理局2023年压力测试中涉及的银行，以及另外两家具有系统重要性的欧洲机构，并使用了2015年至2024年的日数据。分析涵盖了四个具有经济意义的子时期，以评估不同宏观金融环境下系统间联系的演变情况。研究发现，所选择的尾部风险度量方式会对网络拓扑结构、中心性排名和社区构成产生显著影响。实证结果表明，网络的结构特征随时间发生了显著变化。。研究方法：GARCH 波动率模型、回归分析。

papers.title: The Impact of Market Liberalisation on Bank Performance: Evidence From South and Southeast Asian Countries
papers.abstract: Utilising annual data covering 1995–2022, this study examines the effects of market liberalisation on bank performance in 19 South and Southeast Asian countries. Bank performance is assessed using three dimensions: efficiency, profitability, and stability. Market liberalisation is measured using the Economic Freedom Index, Financial Freedom Index, Fiscal Freedom Index, Business Freedom Index, Trade Freedom Index, Monetary Freedom Index, Investment Freedom Index, and Labour Freedom Index. The data are analysed using the GMM estimation approach, and the findings are validated using the Driscoll‐Kraay effect estimator with instrumental variables, along with a robustness test to the GFC‐crisis interaction. Different measures of market liberalisation have varying effects on bank performance. Under GMM, economic freedom is the only index with a robust, positive, and statistically significant impact across all three performance dimensions; this result holds for efficiency and profitability under DKIV, though significance for stability is not confirmed under the stricter identification strategy. Subsample analyses reveal pronounced income‐group heterogeneity: identical liberalisation measures can stabilise banks in low‐income contexts but destabilise them in high‐income economies, rendering a uniform liberalisation agenda suboptimal. The study concludes with critical policy implications.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究利用1995年至2022年的年度数据，分析了市场自由化对19个南亚和东南亚国家银行绩效的影响。银行绩效通过三个维度进行评估：效率、盈利能力和稳定性。市场自由化的程度通过经济自由指数、金融自由指数、财政自由指数、商业自由指数、贸易自由指数、货币自由指数、投资自由指数和劳动自由指数来衡量。数据采用广义矩估计（GMM）方法进行分析，并通过Driscoll-Kraay效应估计器（结合工具变量）对研究结果进行验证，同时还对全球金融危机（GFC）与市场自由化之间的交互作用进行了稳健性检验。不同类型的市场自由化措施对银行绩效的影响各不相同。在GMM模型下，经济自由指数是唯一一个在所有三个绩效维度上都表现出稳健、正向且统计上显著的指标；在DKIV模型下，这一结果同样适用于效率与盈利能力维度，但在更严格的识别策略下，稳定性维度的显著性并未得到证实。子样本分析显示了明显的收入群体差异：相同的自由化措施可能在低收入国家稳定银行体系，却在高收入国家引发不稳定，这说明统一的市场自由化政策可能并非最佳选择。研究最后提出了相关的政策建议。。研究方法：工具变量、广义矩估计。

papers.title: Cost‐of‐Carry Dynamics in China's Crude Oil Futures: The Role of Macro‐Financial Term Structures
papers.abstract: The deepening financialisation of commodities has intensified the complex macro‐linkages within emerging energy markets. This paper investigates the dynamic connectedness among China's crude oil futures (INE), interest rates and exchange rates from a term‐structure perspective (level, slope and curvature). Employing the Nelson–Siegel model and a time‐varying parameter vector auto‐regression (TVP‐VAR) framework based on daily data from March 2018 to June 2025, we analyse the spillover effects of term structure factors to trace their interconnections across short‐term, medium‐term and long‐term horizons. Empirical results reveal that the exchange rate acts as a primary risk transmitter, whereas the interest rate functions as a shock absorber. Notably, system connectivity intensifies during crises, with interest rates reversing roles to become a net transmitter during the Russia–Ukraine conflict. Additionally, the INE market remains a passive price taker, heavily constrained by macro‐financial shocks. Crucially, geopolitical risk and energy price uncertainty exert significant non‐linear moderating effects on this cross‐market network. These findings provide implications for managing cross‐market risks in emerging derivatives markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】商品金融化的加深加剧了新兴能源市场内部复杂的宏观关联。本文从期限结构（水平、斜率和曲率）的角度，研究了中国原油期货（INE）、利率和汇率之间的动态关联性。利用Nelson–Siegel模型和基于2018年3月至2025年6月日数据的时变参数向量自回归（TVP–VAR）框架，我们分析了期限结构因素的溢出效应，以追踪它们在短期、中期和长期范围内的相互联系。实证结果表明，汇率是主要的风险传导媒介，而利率则起到缓冲作用。值得注意的是，在危机期间，系统关联性会增强，特别是在俄乌冲突期间，利率的角色发生了逆转，成为净风险传导因素。此外，INE市场仍然是一个被动的价格接受者，受到宏观经济金融冲击的严重制约。地缘政治风险和能源价格不确定性对这一跨市场网络具有显著的非线性调节作用。这些发现为管理新兴衍生品市场中的跨市场风险提供了启示。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Price Stability, Financial Stability and Central Bank Effectiveness: A Common‐Agency Perspective
papers.abstract: This article considers the institutional design of monetary policy and the trade‐offs faced by central banks when they try to tackle both price and financial stability at the same time. The complementarity between monetary and macroprudential policies has been highlighted in terms of objectives and operational implementation, the ‘divine coincidence’. Nevertheless, the assignment of both mandates to the same institution has not remained unchallenged. While the literature typically assumes homogeneous preferences of the public/society, in this article we introduce agency considerations, reflecting heterogeneous preferences of policymakers and the public. We adopt a common‐agency framework, accounting for formal central bank mandates along with external pressure on monetary policy, to analyse under which conditions it is optimal to assign price and financial stability mandates to one or two separate institutions. Our results show that the ability to achieve a set of given monetary and financial stability targets does not depend on the number of tasks an institution is assigned, but on the degree of independence of the institution itself.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文探讨了货币政策的制度设计，以及中央银行在同时致力于实现价格稳定和金融稳定目标时所面临的权衡。从目标设定和操作实施的角度来看，货币政策与宏观审慎政策之间存在互补性，这种互补性被称作“天作之合”。然而，将这两项任务委托给同一机构的做法并非没有争议。尽管现有文献通常假设公众/社会的偏好是同质的，但在本文中我们引入了代理理论，以反映政策制定者和公众之间存在的偏好差异。我们采用了一个“共同代理”框架，综合考虑了中央银行的正式职责以及外部对货币政策的压力，分析了在何种情况下将价格稳定和金融稳定目标分别委托给一个或两个独立机构才是最优选择。研究结果表明，能否实现既定的货币政策和金融稳定目标，并不取决于某一机构被赋予的任务数量，而取决于该机构自身的独立性程度。。
